product_constraint: Full50%–200% realAPI Decode uplift; configured maximum depth2/3; exact target/greedy output; jointPrefill/TTFT/Decode/total.
selection_rule: Generate original primary chain with existing confidence0.4 stop and retain per-step top1 probabilities. Obtain first-step second-ranked token/probability from same complete head. For actual count m>=2, replace ONLY final primary node by first-token sibling iff log(p_first_second)>sum(log(p_primary_i),i=0..m-1). Equal scores and count1 retain linear. Fixed comparison, no tunable threshold/rank/width/depth scan or learned scoring. Maxdepth2/3 and original target row budget m+1 preserved.
charged_work: Primary MTP steps remain m, including unused primary tail after substitution. Top2 selection and last-step confidence add cost, never assumed free. Witness distinguishes physical MTP steps, retained nodes and unused candidates.
topology: Nodes0..m-1 retain primary prefix; node0=seed. Node m is original tail(parentm-1) or alternate first token(parent0, absoluteentry+1). <=4nodes; noM5 or extra recurrent snapshot slot.

state_contract.gdn_conv: Each node reads parent immutable GDN state; Conv restores parent state before sibling update. All output snapshots immutable. No sibling state contamination.
state_contract.attention: RoPE uses logical depth. Ordered QK/softmax/PV see committed prefix plus node ancestors only. Alternate logicalposition entry+1 may live in physicalslot entry+m; no primary sibling/descendant leakage. Preserve scalar arithmetic.
state_contract.commit: Select matching child from target prediction. Full selected GDN/Conv/hidden/logits and selected-path KV must be canonical before EACH observer; draft reconciles target hidden. EOS/cancel/failure/poison/reset exact.
state_contract.graphs_memory: Fixed parent topology at startup; linear graph remains for no substitution. No request allocation/capture. Existing<=4node bound; plan explicit KV staging and metadata, recheck8GiB reserve and graph ownership. No non-MTP changes.

reference: Medusa ancestor-only tree verification https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.10774; algorithm study only, no trained heads, imported code or dependency. Hybrid parent-state correctness requires independent native proof.
milestones: Host controller/topology plus exact parent-state verifier. Exhaustive linear/branch/EOS/cancel/reject paths, complete scalar path state/logit comparison and sibling isolation.
Complete Graph/lifetime/route/resource composition, immediately real d2 P65/8K/40K API. Useful full direction unlocks d3. No performance inheritance from diagnostic.

bounds.rollback: Archive after correctness failure beyond repair, expired composition budget or globally negative real API. Local wins cannot override whole runner.

performance_gate: Freeze binary and precise stop/retention protocol before first native API timing.
